$schema-note: Hand-rolled strict subset (no jsonschema dependency). Validated by tools/xr_schema.py (contract id ledger-identity-overlay) and, for every successful vector, by tools/ledger_identity_check.py. identity_id is REQUIRED: there is no optional form and no default. The mint shape (xr: + v4-shaped UUID) is enforced by BOTH backends (identity/core/ledger_tag.cc via DomainShapeOk, fakes/ledger_identity.py domain_shape_ok), because this validator has no pattern keyword. event is the wrapped event of any class, carried byte-for-byte; its own contract (block-event-v1, policy-change-event-v1, permission-audit-event-v1, the frozen ActivityRow export) is unchanged.
